74601: Suzu is an innocent, kind-hearted girl from a seaside town called Eba in Hiroshima, who then moves to Kure after marrying Shuusaku Houjou. She loves drawing and has a knack for it.
127827: Suzu's husband. Earnest and quiet person. A judicial officer at Military Court in Kure.
146458: A pretty courtesan working in Kure with whom Suzu talks and befriends to after getting lost in the city. She had an unhappy childhood and met Suzu once, back when she was still a gamin.
146460: Sumi is the younger sister of Suzu and cares a lot about her. In her younger years she's portrayed, while she's either helping Suzu with her chores or playing with her.
